name: elb-healthcheck-diagnostic
description: Auto-diagnoses Elastic Load Balancing UnHealthyHostCount events - pulls the target-group health-check config and DescribeTargetHealth failure reason codes, validates security-group rules (ALB outbound and target inbound), cross-references the health-check port and protocol with the app config, and checks grace-period misconfiguration - then produces a ranked, read-only-safe remediation plan. Read-only. Recommends the AWS Documentation MCP as augmentation and references the existing load-balancer-health-investigator skill conceptually.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on FRI at 18:00 UTC
